outgoing.name: Alexander the Great
outgoing.section: The decision to erect the statue
outgoing.excerpt: Alexander the Great died at an early age in 323 BC without having had time to put into place any plans for his succession.

outgoing.name: Earthquake
outgoing.excerpt: The statue stood for only fifty-six years until Rhodes was hit by an earthquake in 224 BC.

outgoing.name: New York City
outgoing.excerpt: It was roughly the same size as the Statue of Liberty in New York, although it stood on a lower platform.

outgoing.name: Zeus
outgoing.section: The decision to erect the statue
outgoing.excerpt: His teacher, the famed sculptor Lysippus, had constructed a sixty-foot-high statue of Zeus.
